snippet.title: New PVE Extraction Survival Game Is Out! Play & Get Marketable Steam Items! | Nuclear Epoch
snippet.description:
The gates to the radioactive wasteland are finally open. Survivors, your ultimate journey begins NOW!

Nuclear Epoch is a brand-new post-apocalyptic PVE Extraction Survival & Crafting game, now officially launched on Steam! Gear up, raid high-radiation zones, defeat mutant bosses, and bring back rare loot that actually converts into Marketable Steam Inventory Items!

👉 Play Nuclear Epoch on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4049910/_/

🌟 KEY FEATURES:
Thrilling PVE Extraction Gameplay: Venture deep into dangerous areas like the "Poisonous Marsh". Hunt mutated beasts and retrieve valuable loot. Extract safely to keep everything, or die and lose it all!
Earn Real Steam Inventory Drops: Defeat bosses to unlock rare crates containing cosmetic items, computation chips, and resource vouchers—all of which are genuine Steam inventory items that can be traded on the Steam Community Market!
Advanced Base Building & Automation: Build your high-tech sanctuary in the wasteland. Set up automatic watering and fertilizing systems to farm elemental crops and craft legendary Tier-5 weapons!
Dragon Taming & Breeding: Find and hatch dragon eggs in the wild. Feed them elemental resources to boost their stats, unlock 16 devastating combat abilities, and breed the ultimate generation of wasteland dragons!


If you enjoyed the trailer, please LIKE, COMMENT, and SUBSCRIBE! Let us know in the comments: Would you focus on base building, dragon taming, or farming Steam drops? 👇
